events.text: Delay in match because of an injury Thomas Meunier (Sunderland).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Sunderland. Malick Fofana replaces Thomas Meunier because of an injury.
Olivier Boscagli (Brighton and Hove Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Sunderland 0, Brighton and Hove Albion 0.
Second Half begins Sunderland 0, Brighton and Hove Albion 0.
Goal! Sunderland 0, Brighton and Hove Albion 1. Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton and Hove Albion) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Pascal Groß.
Pascal Struijk (Brighton and Hove Albion) is shown the red card.

Goal! Sunderland 0, Brighton and Hove Albion 2. Jaouen Hadjam (Brighton and Hove Albion) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Georginio Rutter following a fast break.
